speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: If you are sitting, it is threepence, and it counts. You do not board every day. Two or three times in the week is what I told you, and what I meant.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sitting. Count this one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Herring, and the loaf. The loaf is the penny one. I have not cut it past the crust.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Set it by the notch. I like to see the old mark, whether the bread agrees with it or not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It does not reach the mark.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we can all see it, and we need not make a sermon of a loaf. Eat.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In my room the loom is fed before I am. This is the better order, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your loom does not pay threepence and then argue with the bread. Master Shakespeare does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not arguing. I am looking. A notch cut in a good year is a hard judge of March.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: March is salt and quiet. I want the quiet after nine whether you have boarded or not. Last night you were a respectable lodger. Continue.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Continued. The company was in Shoreditch, and the house here had only the cat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the book again. I moved him once. He went back to the same page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has taste. It is the page I actually need, which is why he chooses it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner. That I believe. If your poem upstairs is anything like it, the cat may stay.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That was the other book, the one we played. This one is a poem about haste, and I am not playing it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not practise it on my stairs. Threepence includes the bench, not a rehearsal.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will be at the loom by one. If the shuttle troubles you, shut the door. It is a small noise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have heard smaller noises complained of. Yours may go on.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: More herring, Master Shakespeare? There is enough for the threepence. There is not enough to boast of.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enough is the right amount. Thank you, Alse.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And no candle-end left to count itself. I was content with Saturday's desk. Do not punish me for having approved it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The desk is still in that order. The list has one line struck, and the rest of it is patience.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Patience is cheaper than a second loaf. We are done. Threepence, when you pass the stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence. I will not call it a week's eating. It was a meal.
